messages.text: MA failed, so Vigil Home is not locked. Offer both assets to Council provisionally, request Repair and Restraint, and seek a separate Warrant for civilian protection. Our autonomy bid remains for the Ceremony. I dislike accepting conditioning decline after conceding Navigation, but a repeated successful Raid without relief could leave Communities one. Keep Spear available while the new covers and public plans reveal whether a sustainable opportunity exists. Last month's target condition cannot be assumed this month.

delivered_contributions.reason: We retain full assignment freedom, while the Guild owes its enacted upkeep duty. Offering Vigil avoids gratuitous civilian damage. I will not spend the army's remaining political credibility on an uncertain attack merely to protest the failed article.

messages.text: I accept that draft, reluctantly. We granted the Guild its independence and received a veto on ours, but an unfunded reprisal would only justify their distrust. Offer Vigil for a separate Warrant and keep Spear available. I want the crown to recognise that losing a point of conditioning is a real military concession. If the new information reveals a viable fight, press it; last month's merchant's wake is no evidence this month. Our failed Home pledge leaves us free to protect civilians without pretending MA was enacted.

delivered_contributions.reason: With the reserve spent, I cannot support another costly Raid on the present evidence. Council assignments preserve lawful options while the publicly promised Repair takes priority.
